messages:
tess_sales: Hey team — AcmeBank wants to move the POC into preflight week. They require customer‑managed keys (HSM-backed CMKs), cross‑region key failover, explicit rotation windows (they asked for a 7‑day rotation policy), and separation of HSM billing. Can @omar_se and @leah_cryptoops confirm whether we can meet these technically and what the pricing delta / SOW language looks like? Also legal handed a short KMS section of the security questionnaire to fill.

omar_se: Quick clarifying q's — when they say '7‑day rotation' do they mean automated rotation every 7 days, or the maximum allowed time between rotations? Also are they expecting zero‑downtime rekeying (live rollover) or a maintenance window?

tess_sales: Good call — customer says 'automated every 7 days if possible, but must support manual ceremonies'. They also said zero‑downtime is preferred but can tolerate a 30‑min window during cutover.

leah_cryptoops: We support both automated scheduled rotations via our control plane and manual import/ceremony flows for BYOK. For zero‑downtime you can use a dual‑active key id pattern: generate new key, start signing/encrypting with new + accept old for decryption for a configurable overlap. If they need HSM attestation we can accept CloudHSM or Luna imports with attestation metadata.

leah_cryptoops: Example rotation pattern we provide (high level):
```
1) import/derive new key material into HSM with attestation
2) update gateway routing to start writing with new key + read using both
3) after overlap window, retire old key and update audit record
```

sam_security: From the questionnaire perspective, please confirm these items: HSM vendor + FIPS level, key import attestation artifact, KMS audit log retention (they asked for 1 year), no key escrow, and support for customer KMS lifecycle audit. Also, they want confirmation we can route KMS traffic over their VPC peering and whitelisted IPs.

omar_se: Network note: we'll need to document egress IPs and a sample firewall rule. Also need projected QPS and token volumes to size Dedicated HSM pool. Tess — can you ask Acme for expected peak keys/sec and monthly token estimate?

mike_finance: Pricing notes — rough starter model for presales: HSM add‑on = $3k/mo per HSM appliance equivalent (covers attestation and HSM ops) + a small per‑request markup. If they want dedicated reserved HSM capacity we'll quote a 12‑mo commit with volume tiers. I can draft an SOW paragraph with these numbers once we have their QPS.

ops‑bot: Ticket created: INC‑2026‑8123 — "AcmeBank POC: BYOK/HSM preflight & pricing". Meeting scheduled: 2026‑02‑12 10:00 PT (calendar invite sent).

leah_cryptoops: A couple of caveats: (1) very frequent rotations (every few days) increases KV cache invalidation and adds throughput; that affects latency for chat generation workloads — call it out in the SOW. (2) For multi‑region failover we replicate key metadata but not raw key material across vendors; we recommend active‑passive region failover with rehydration procedure documented.

sam_security: Add to questionnaire answer: we require an initial attestation package (signed cert chain) for imported keys and we record HSM audit logs at token level. We'll provide the standard template clause for 'no escrow' and 'customer sole control of key material'.

omar_se: I'll draft a 1‑page technical scoping note (network ports, sample firewall allowlist, expected QPS impact, rotation overlap pattern) and post here by EOD.

mike_finance: I'll draft the SOW paragraph + pricing floor and attach a few pricing scenarios (payg + reserved).

ops‑bot: Link to ticket/inc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC‑2026‑8123

_tess_sales: Awesome — action items: (1) Tess ask Acme for QPS/token estimates + confirm whether they want automated 7‑day or manual; (2) Omar to post tech scoping note; (3) Leah to prepare attestation + rotation caveats for questionnaire; (4) Mike to draft SOW pricing. Meeting on 2026‑02‑12 to finalize. Thanks team :thumbsup:
